summary: Demchok Dorje studied under Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso and Khenpo Shenga.

Denis Sinor was a scholar of linguistics and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied under Paul Pelliot and at the University of Cambridge, later holding posts at Cambridge and Indiana University.

A scholar of Sinology and history, Denis Twitchett studied at SOAS and St Catharine's College. He held Chairs of Chinese at the University of London and the University of Cambridge, later serving as Emeritus Professor at Princeton University.

Denise Bernot worked in linguistics, having studied at the École des chartes and École des langues orientales. She held a long-term post at the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales from circa 1960 to 1989.

Denma Lochö Rinpoche was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Drepung Loseling Monastery and Gyume Tantric Monastery. He served as principal of the Institute of Buddhist Dialectics and abbot of Namgyal Monastery.
Dennis A. Johnson is a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his Magister der Philosophie at the University of Vienna, where he was supervised by Klaus-Dieter Mathes.

Dennis Genpo Merzel is a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar. He studied at the University of Southern California and its Rossier School of Education, and trained under Taizan Maezumi from circa 1972 to 1995.

Dennis Hirota is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at UC Berkeley and Nagoya University. He served as a professor at Ryukoku University, was affiliated with the Hongwanji International Center, and was a visiting professor at Harvard.
Denzaburo Yoshizawa was a philosopher who studied at the University of Tokyo under Tetsuro Watsuji. He held academic posts at Tokyo Metropolitan University and Iryo Sosei University.

A scholar of Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies, Derek F. Maher earned degrees from Evergreen State College and the University of Virginia under Jeffrey Hopkins. He held posts at Virginia, UNC Greensboro, and East Carolina University.

Dermot Killingley is an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied at Oxford, Merton College, and SOAS. He held posts at the University of Malaya, Newcastle University, and the University of Vienna.

Dermott Walsh is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Japanology. He studied at Trinity College Dublin, Leiden University, and the University of California, Los Angeles, completing his PhD under William M. Bodiford.

Devadatta Ramakrishna Bhandarkar was an Indologist and historian. He served as Superintendent of the Archaeological Survey of India's Western Circle and as Carmichael Professor of Ancient Indian History and Culture at the University of Calcutta.
Dewei Zhang specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He earned his PhD at the University of British Columbia under the supervision of Jinhua Chen.
Dezhung Kunga Gyaltsen studied under Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Khenpo Shenga.

Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under teachers including Gaton Ngawang Lekpa and Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse, and participated in a research project at the University of Washington.

Dharmananda Damodar Kosambi was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at Harvard University in 1926. He held posts at the University of Calcutta, Harvard, Gujarat University, and Saint Petersburg State University.
Dhirendra Mohan Datta was an Indologist and philosopher who studied at the University of Calcutta. He held academic posts at Patna College and the University of Minnesota.
Dhirendra Sharma is a scholar in the fields of philosophy and Indology who studied under David Friedman and Surendra Sharma.
Dhivan Thomas Jones works in Buddhist studies and philosophy, having studied under Richard Gombrich and Margaret Cone. He has held teaching posts at the Open University and the University of Chester.
